profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer
profile.geoLocationName: Salt Lake City, Utah, United States
profile.summary: I take "Full Stack" to a whole new level. I've done front end, back end, software, firmware, and hardware. I have fought in every trench of the IoT battlefield. This top to bottom experience makes me an excellent systems architect. I have a 10,000 foot view that few others have.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description: Team lead, System Architect, Systems Engineer and occasional developer. Years of experience working with government clients on fixed bid contracts. I'm known for finishing on time and on budget.

positions.title: Senior Firmware Engineer
positions.description: Senior Firmware Engineer, Cloud Architect, Systems Engineer and Technical Lead.

positions.title: Firmware Engineer
positions.description: Embedded Systems Firmware Engineer. Working in all stages of product development including: proposal, requirements, design, specification, implementation, debugging, manufacturing, and maintenance. Projects include internet connected wireless mesh networked radiation detection devices, International Space Station deployed communications payloads and mass produced consumer electronics with several wireless technologies including Bluetooth, Cellular, WiFi, and 802.15.4.

positions.title: Hardware Engineering Research Assistant
positions.locationName: College of Electrical And Computer Engineering
positions.description: Designed the low power wireless sensor module for a 1700 node network for collecting contact data for the Wireless Embedded Sensor Laboratory (WiESEL).

positions.title: Co-Op Engineer
positions.description: Assisted the Lead Test Engineer in charge of the Predator Primary Data Link for the USAF Predator MQ-9 Unmanned Aerial Vehicle platform.

positions.title: Electronic Technician
positions.description: Schematic capture and PCB layout. Manufacturing PCB inspection and rework.

volunteerExperiences.description: Created engaging and interactive presentations for high school students to introduce them to the engineering profession.

publications.title: Rapid deployable system for human contact network research
publications.publisher: Proceedings of the 10th ACM Conference on Embedded Network Sensor Systems · Nov 1, 2012
